# Task Scheduler schema fixture

`task-scheduler-1.3.xsd` is the XSD published in Microsoft Learn's
[Task Scheduler Schema](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/taskschd/task-scheduler-schema)
article. It is reproduced unchanged and is used only by tests to validate
generated Task Scheduler XML. It is not compiled into or distributed with the
neo-js library or CLI.

- Retrieved: 2026-11-18

  `c8e002db774b7630d7063aa9ecc5d184624df698`
- SHA-256 of the fixture:

- Changes: none; the XSD text was extracted from the article's code block.
